news.headline: Welcome to the future of lighting

paragraphs: Amerlux makes lighting fixtures, pitched as lighting solutions to elevate any space and increase occupant comfort. The buyers it addresses are architects, designers, and owners tuning atmosphere, white clarity, and color vibrancy. The markets named run from retail and hospitality to healthcare, education, and infrastructure.

An exterior range covers outside environments, framed as light that makes those places safer. Product listings tag several exterior families for commercial, institutional, municipal, smart cities, and utility markets. Indoors, downlights run from ultra-small 1-inch to jumbo 8-inch apertures. Those downlight families are named as Stadia, Finch, Evoke, Hornet HP, Essenza and Classix.

Linear lighting is handled by Carisma, a family of architectural linear luminaires. Specifiers can filter products by building code designations such as Chicago Plenum-CCEA, Title 24, and IC Products. One lens option is rated at a luminous efficacy of 125+ lm/W, which the company ties to lower energy bills and carbon footprint. The home page points visitors to fixtures unveiled at LEDucation in 2026.

quote.text: If you’re illuminating a humble parking garage or an entire city, there’s no application that can’t be improved with beautiful light from Amerlux.
